analysis.permitted_conclusion: NEXUS evolved an executable learning procedure that acquired bounded hidden mechanisms more efficiently than its handwritten learner and transferred to independently generated grammar families. This is genuine evidence of bounded learning-to-learn; it does not establish AGI, unrestricted self-improvement, or general language intelligence.
